text: Papaya, carrot, mango, milk
What it does: Keeps eyes and skin healthy
Deficiency disorder: Loss of vision
Possible signs; not a diagnosis: Poor vision; loss of vision in dimlight (night blindness); in severe cases, complete loss of vision
Legumes, nuts, whole grains,seeds, milk products
What it does: Helps release energy from food and supports nervefunction
Deficiency disorder: Beriberi
Possible signs; not a diagnosis: Swelling, tingling or burning inthe feet and hands; difficulty in breathing
Amla, guava, green chilli,orange, lemon
What it does: Needed to make collagen for connective tissues andwound healing
Possible signs; not a diagnosis: Bleeding gums; wounds healslowly
Skin makes it in sunlight;oily fish, egg yolk, fortifiedmilk
What it does: Helps the body absorb calcium for bones and teeth
Deficiency disorder: Rickets
Possible signs; not a diagnosis: Soft, bent bones
Milk, curd, cheese, paneer;calcium-fortified soya milk
What it does: Keeps bones and teeth strong
Deficiency disorder: Poor bone mineralisation
Possible signs; not a diagnosis: Low intake over time can weakenbones; tooth decay has other causes
Iodised salt, seafood, dairyand eggs; amounts vary
What it does: Needed to make thyroid hormones, supportinggrowth and development
Deficiency disorder: Goitre
Possible signs; not a diagnosis: Swelling at the front of the neck
Pulses, leafy greens, meatand iron-fortified foods;absorption varies
What it does: Part of haemoglobin, which carries oxygen in blood
Deficiency disorder: Anaemia
Possible signs; not a diagnosis: Weakness; shortness of breath
